UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user account profile storing email and username.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Normalized email address of the user.

username.description: Display username chosen by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was last updated.

ChatSessionDoc.title: ChatSessionDoc
ChatSessionDoc.description: Saved chat conversation belonging to a specific user email account.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

userEmail.description: Email address associated with this saved chat session.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages in the conversation.

messagesSummary.description: Serialized conversation messages bounded for Firestore document storage.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat session was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat session was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Saved chat sessions belonging to the user.
